title: Missing Minotaurs
tagline: Aid the Missing Minotaurs to escape from the intricate and perplexing Labyrinth.
description:
How to Play: 

The minotaurs are lost inside the mystifying labyrinth – It is a 6x6 plot ruined by the labyrinth’s curse. 

Clicking anywhere either adds tiles to blank ones or remove tiles to existing ones in a cross pattern.

Select tiles to replicate the road pattern given to pave the pathway out! 



Requirements:

To play, you will need to mint a missing minotaur for 10 MATIC, and as each puzzle game is unique and on-chain, you will need to stake 1 MATIC to play the puzzle game. 	

You win by replicating the Road pattern under 20 minutes. 

You will then get your stake back and earn your reward. 

If you fail to complete the puzzle on time, you will retrieve your reduced stake. 



Tech:

 Our project is made with Solidity and Moralis SDK to connect to the Polygon blockchain. The minotaurs are hosted on the IPFS using NFT.Storage. The frontend was built with React which was then deployed on Valist software distribution.



Roadmap:

•	More mechanics and assets for the puzzle game.

•	Improve security

•	More NFT partners

•	Time Attack Tournament 

•	Higher Stake Harder Puzzle



That’s about it – A mind-boggling play-to-earn puzzle game to free a herd of 499 Missing Minotaurs.
